about: Every number and claim this lesson shows or says, with its source. AI lane (_shared/lanes.md): the reply on screen is the exact text the studio-ai-demo workflow got back from Gemini on Nov 1, 2026 (video/studio/demos/out/2026-11-14-ai-night-quote-4/run.json). Gemini's plan page and app page are phone shots taken by the same workflow on Nov 1, 2026 (demos/out/2026-11-14-ai-night-quote-1/page-1.png and -2/page-2.png). Jobber's report page was read Oct 29, 2026 for 2026-11-08-after-hours-reply and again Nov 1, 2026 by the fresh facts reviewers' web fetch (the workflow's browser timed out on it in job 1 and got a 403 bot check in job 2). The customer's text, the 11 pm and 7 am times and the owner's usual reply are ours (EXAMPLE on screen).

jobber.title: Blue Collar Strong: The 2026 Home Service Trends Report
jobber.quote: Cleaning businesses are the fastest responders (26% reply within an hour), while HVAC pros are the slowest.
jobber.method: a survey of 1,050 home service business owners across the United States, conducted through Conjointly in December 2025, with a margin of error of plus or minus 3 percentage points at the 90% confidence level
jobber.scope: Self-reported by owners. The page does not give the cleaning subsample size. Descriptive survey data, not a correlation.
jobber.context: The same page: 20% of all pros respond within the hour (not used in the video).

demo.modelAsked: gemini-3.5-flash (the Gemini app's default as its page showed it Nov 1; the API returned modelVersion gemini-3.6-flash)
demo.prompt:
Reply to this cleaning quote text for me. Friendly, under 50 words. My price: [your price]. Ask one question if anything's missing.

Their text: "Hi! Need a quote for a move-out clean, 2 bed 1 bath, before Friday. Thanks!"
demo.reply:
Hi! I’d love to help with your move-out clean. For a 2-bed, 1-bath, my rate is [your price]. 

Could you let me know if you need the inside of the oven or fridge included? 

Let me know what day before Friday works best for you!
questions: Could you let me know if you need the inside of the oven or fridge included?
Let me know what day before Friday works best for you!
demo.gotWrong: The prompt asked for one question if anything was missing; the reply asks two (oven or fridge, and what day). The owner cuts one, puts in a real price for [your price], and sends it.
demo.where: Run through Google's Gemini API on GitHub's machine (tools/ai_demo.py), not typed into the Gemini app; the reply is shown as the model returned it, labelled with the model and date. The free app plan runs Flash-Lite (plan page, Nov 1), so an owner's reply in the free app will read differently; the card says (API).

confirms: Get everyday help from Google AI to tackle tasks at work, school or home.
appConfirms: Hi, I'm Gemini. Where should we start?
Gemini is AI and can make mistakes.
